resolution_2026_10_01.method: Live community-source inspection plus canonical/runtime integration; no direct game build or playthrough certification.

finding_sources.boundary: Some source rows still give only an area or relative landmark, not a full save-point approach. Exact earliest movement/access remains BBS-003; official ordering is BBS-002. The eight Secret Episode source rows repeat room names only, and the tutorial has no added route. Guiding-key is fully accessible through web retrieval despite direct HTTP 403; no access blocker is claimed.

World/album inventories and GameFAQs Reports lists do not establish an independently reconciled HD Reports sequence for all 374 main chests. Source numbering remains source order, not certified UI numbering.

KHWiki calls High Jump required for Ventus Cottage Clearing and Mousehole stickers, while KHRealm describes stump/swing and falling-Sliding-Dash alternatives. Minimum levels are unresolved. Land of Departure sources conflict over late access: Fandom says inaccessible after story; FM trophy forum search reports post-Eraqus access but full page errors; Unknown page qualifies accessible save files. No permanent-missable claim is made.

finding_sources.boundary: No missing per-sticker placement text. Pixel-perfect hitboxes are not required to follow the illustrated landmarks; use seven-point feedback and avoid overlapping stickers.
Exact minimum Ignite level remains 3 in KHWiki versus 1 in guiding-key; Destiny Islands omits levels. This is not a whole-pair quarantine.
Acquisition and mastery completeness are separately tracked as BBS-010/012.

Not every command page has a BBS acquisition list. The 108 legacy shop rows are not yet a complete normalized character-specific AND/OR gate table; purchased/previously-obtained and board mode conditions must remain separate. Per-command source URLs are in command-catalog.json.
Individual command and enemy tables provide world drop rates but not a complete character/room/reset inventory. No-drop text means no recorded route, not evidence that a command cannot drop.

Roster versus individual page conflicts: Collision Magnet 4 vs 5, Blizzaga 3 vs 4, Homing Slide 4 vs 1. Five Illusions, High Jump and Barrier lack complete parsed curves. Item/max-level-one rows are not missing curves. CP source fields remain distinguishable from acquisition.

Chaos, Secret Gem and Command Meld pages and independent item guide state random ability without exhaustive pool weights or conditional distribution. No uniform distribution is inferred from that word.

Complete enemy-room-character/reset coverage remains absent. Destiny Islands bestiary supplies nested item percentages (must multiply by enemy drop probability) and Shop Level bands, but not full character-specific room routes; existing crystal sources cover 12 relationships, not all farms. No fastest-farm certification is claimed.

KHWiki explicitly requests BBS mechanics cleanup, and no independent edition-specific probability derivation was found. Formula is labeled community-sourced; it cannot certify comparative fastest routes or guaranteed drops.
Accessible farm routes belong to BBS-015.

Independent Destiny Islands weapons table lacks FM additions and disagrees on Sweetstack strength (7 vs modern 8) and Pixie Petal critical multiplier (1.35 vs 1.5). KHWiki reach sometimes says Long rather than a number. Complete independently verified modern stats remain open.

Making unlocks later purchase, and story-awarded ice creams exist; whether every alternative satisfies each modern obtain/make/achievement predicate is not established by the sources. Recipe arithmetic is validated separately from complete independent numeric certification.
Risky Riches conflicting pod headcounts were deliberately omitted; ingredient-per-hit routing does not require that count.

Combined Threat aggregate story/clear-file conditions conflict with HD guide Arena 7; A Time to Chill aggregate story conditions conflict with individual Arena 13. Exact cross-file and ticket AND/OR logic remains unresolved for those battles.
A Time to Chill HP reward is +5 on individual page versus +10 on world Bonus Levels table; retained explicit conflict rather than selecting one. Arena 13 access contradiction is BBS-021.
The older Moogle page 205 value is superseded by Battle Ticket and Arena/item tables.

Five source sections have inclusive tables versus strict prose: Vitality Vial 2:00, Ringer40, Gluttonous Goo90, Element Cluster70 and Floating Flora350. No decisive exact-boundary evidence was found; aim beyond those thresholds. Rank/strategy extraction itself is complete.
None for the stated score/reward/strategy catalog. Command Board panel inventory is separately BBS-027; no best-time guarantee is claimed.

Command Board table says most bonus panels are absent in Arena, not all; complete seven-board per-panel/mode inventories are not fully normalized. A current-copy prerequisite must not be replaced with ever-obtained semantics.

KHWiki Finish Commands, Destiny Islands finish guide and community discussion explain eligible parent progression but do not establish whether switching away resets counters or merely pauses them. No reset rule is invented.

Temporary D-Link decks and finisher actions, exact emblem-drop probabilities and full usage mechanics remain incomplete. Vanitas temporary and removed wireless links are explicitly outside persistent acquisition.

Full attack/stat tables remain incomplete in sources: Unknown page explicitly requests BBS attack-name/stat cleanup and has unknown damage/block fields; some boss pages mix PSP/HD behavior. Brief encounter notes do not close full per-character strategy/recovery coverage.

KHWiki unlock pages and mixed-difficulty Steam/community reports do not agree on exact save aggregation/re-save algorithm across builds. No deletion/replay workaround is recommended as verified behavior.
Exact Steam API IDs, hidden flag metadata, mixed-save aggregation and current-build Collector glitch behavior are not independently certified. PS3-era workaround reports do not establish a Steam bug.

Community inspection is not direct gameplay/build verification. No exact Steam executable version or primary mechanics dump was available; original workbook reads remain historical, not newly fetched.
The remembered functional workbook/application is not present in inspected repository artifacts. The recovered reference establishes data lineage but cannot reconstruct absent historical behavior.
Atomic consume/undo, full mobile/offline acceptance and other engineering gates remain separately tracked. Data Jiminy intentionally stays empty under current task authorization.
Production art, native pose/animation/weapon integration and physical-device fidelity remain visual/engineering acceptance, not unknown game mechanics.
PSP multiplayer/transfer, KH0.2, mandatory Character Files and tutorial Reports counting remain out of scope. Source-null semantics are preserved.
Ability-identity probabilities remain BBS-013.

findings.outcome: Integrated all eight Secret Episode approach notes from the HD walkthrough; retained 374 main routes and 60 pickups. Full save-point paths and earliest movement levels are still not universal.

findings.outcome: Japanese FM treasure lists explicitly describe numbering from the upper-left, but also disclose original-version copying. They provide a new corroboration lead, not a completed 374-record modern UI reconciliation. The existing source_position values remain source numbering.

Resolved the Land of Departure edition confusion: the world article explicitly limits permanent loss to original Japanese BBS and says later editions retain the ruined world. Added main-save revisit notes, preserving the separate Final Episode restriction. Sticker alternate-route sources still do not certify global minimum movement levels.

The 2015 HD melding guide explicitly derives from Destiny Islands and also omits Ignite’s level for Mine Square, while specifying it elsewhere. This is neither independent corroboration nor proof of level 1. Keep the working level 3 combination and narrow minimum-level dispute.

Expanded board-mode acquisition evidence through every board bonus table. Rechecked Moogle Shop and Stop as an explicit worlds-cleared OR prior-acquisition example. The 108 legacy shop rows still need a complete per-command currency/gate normalization; no global AND/OR rewrite is justified.

Reviewed the independent enemy/farm results and existing conditional-drop catalog. Older forum percentages often omit the outer drop roll or Shop Level; no complete edition-correct character/room/reset inventory emerged. All 38 command drop records retained; absence of a listed drop remains unknown, not impossible.

Blizzaga level 4 is supported by its BBS mechanics/CP table and the independent translation guide; integrated CP steps 580/610/640 and retained the old roster 3 in history. Collision Magnet still has roster/prose/independent max 4 versus infobox 5. Homing Slide has prose/independent max 4 but a one-row CP table; table incompleteness cannot prove max 1. High Jump/Barrier and five Illusions still lack curves.

Chaos/Secret Gem references and specific community questions still do not publish an exhaustive weighted pool conditional on recipe type. Reports that choices are not entirely random are not a complete distribution. No uniform probabilities added.

Additional farm searches surfaced Mandrake/Radiant Garden and Axe Flapper reports, but these do not supply complete character-specific rooms/reset intervals. An old answer even mixes conditional 60–95% figures with outdated medal prices. Kept verified conditional relationships; no fastest route or total coverage asserted.

KHWiki still gives 1 + 0.3n for BBS but retains its BBS-mechanics cleanup notice. Additional exact-formula searches mostly return KH1/KH2 mechanics, which cannot corroborate BBS. No primary or independently edition-specific derivation found.

Corrected a false conflict in the prior ledger: both Destiny Islands and KHWiki give Sweetstack STR 6, matching the unchanged canonical CSV; neither supports the reported 7-versus-8 conflict. Pixie Petal x1.35 versus x1.5 remains real. Numeric reach for FM superboss weapons and complete independent modern certification remain open.

Original ice-cream guide and modern synthesis/item wording corroborate crafting each recipe as the documented Sweetstack route, but do not prove all bought/story-awarded alternatives satisfy identical modern achievement flags. Ingredient totals remain arithmetic-validated, not independently certified in every number.

HD Gamer Guides contradicts itself across summary and detailed unlock entries: Combined Threat says Arena 7, while detailed A Time to Chill lists Aqua Olympus/other-character Aqua clear plus Arena 13. This narrows the apparent Arena 13 contradiction to omitted conjunctions, but ticket bypass of story/cross-file predicates remains unproven. Existing conservative six normalized rules retained.

HD Gamer Guides explicitly corroborates A Time to Chill +10 HP for Ventus/Aqua, agreeing with the world Bonus Levels table; the individual battle-page +5 still conflicts. Added the independent +10 corroboration to runtime uncertainty without silently deciding the conflict.

StrategyWiki independently uses 40+ for Ringer and surviving until 2:00 for Vitality Vial. This supports inclusive table language but supplies no exact-boundary recording for all five conflicting missions. Existing rank bands and conservative aim-beyond advice retained.
